scripts.build:refresh: pnpm run enrich && pnpm run build
scripts.deploy: pnpm run validate && pnpm run test && pnpm run build && pnpm run check:sitemap && pnpm run check:editorial && pnpm run check:links && env -u CF_API_TOKEN -u CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN wrangler deploy
scripts.deploy:dry-run: pnpm run build && env -u CF_API_TOKEN -u CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN wrangler deploy --dry-run
scripts.deploy:refresh: pnpm run enrich && pnpm run deploy
scripts.deploy:redirect: pnpm run test && env -u CF_API_TOKEN -u CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN wrangler deploy --config redirect/wrangler.jsonc
